headline: Lupin双榜领跑，末世行者电影热度登顶
headlineEn: Lupin Leads Both Charts; Doomsday Walker Tops Movie Heat
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅2部新片；电影端《末世行者》热度居首，电视端《Lupin》登顶，并在双榜持续领跑。
summaryEn: No movies released today and only 2 new films this week; Doomsday Walker tops movie heat, while Lupin leads TV and keeps topping both charts.

industryHighlights.text: 今日电影上映数为0，本周仅2部新片，市场以热度竞争为主。
industryHighlights.en: Zero movies released today and only 2 new films this week; heat competition dominates the market.

industryHighlights.text: 《Lupin》同时占据电影与电视热度榜前列，跨榜热度突出。
industryHighlights.en: Lupin ranks high on both movie and TV heat charts, showing strong cross-category momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 《末世行者》领跑今日电影热度，并进入本周电影热度前五。
industryHighlights.en: Doomsday Walker leads today's movie heat and enters this week's movie top five.

industryHighlights.text: 待映新片包括《El despertar》与《猫鼬》。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming releases include El despertar and Mongoose.
